feeds.title: FGN Global Logistics Blog
feeds.description: FGN Global Logistics was founded in 2012 to provide fully integrated flexitank logistics. Our strategy is to be the most highly effective third-party liquid logistics management company in the US market. We are financially conservative and focus on maintaining a strong balance sheet. Our goal is to work smarter, not harder, in order to deliver superior returns.

feeds.title: Liquid Trucking Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 1989, family-owned Liquid Trucking, has grown to one of the 30 largest tank trucking companies in the United States. We pride ourselves on providing the highest quality liquid transport services out of the Midwest, servicing the continental US and Canada. Our world-class facilities, and state-of-the-art GPS-equipped trucks and tankers, driven by the most capable drivers in the industry, are the keys to our success and continued growth.

feeds.title: ener8 Blog
feeds.description: ener8 limited is an independent supply chain consulting business for the liquid bulk & chemical industry, offering comprehensive services to our customers to support the development of resilient and sustainable supply chains. Our blog offers resources, tips, trends, and strategies to help you build resilient and sustainable liquid bulk and chemical supply chains.

feeds.title: Highway Transport Blog
feeds.description: At Highway, we promise to deliver to our partners: not just chemical products but services and solutions. We've built up a solid track record of trust with our customers, and our drivers are committed to maintaining that trust by staying on top of security issues on the road. Our fleet of bulk tankers can meet last-minute logistical challenges, and our dedicated drivers deliver critical loads on time.

feeds.title: Kan-Haul Blog
feeds.description: As one of the nations leading food-grade trucking companies, Kan-Haul has been a leader in establishing the procedures for clean and safe transportation of liquid food products in bulk liquid tankers for close to 30 years. On our blog, you will find topics including shipping, logistics, importing, exporting, and more.

feeds.title: GOCO Transports Blog
feeds.description: GOCO Transports, a division of Gaubert Oil Company, Inc., provides safe, reliable, and efficient transportation of fuels, chemicals, and other liquid products to support a variety of industries. Leveraging over 95 years in the petroleum distribution business, GOCO Transports strives to deliver a frictionless customer experience for our clients and a safe work environment for our employees.
